notes.title: Beta 2.4.5
notes.notes: [p]- Increased forward and backward kicking/dribbling/tackling hitbox reach.[/p][p]- Reworked kick, dribble and juggle charges.[/p][p]- Tweaked ball physics slightly so it should slow down less when rolling on the ground. This won't speed up the ball, just how much it slows down when rolling on the ground and it's not too drastic of a change.[/p][p]- Increased juggle height slightly.[/p][p]- Changed body collision with the ball so it triggers a kick cooldown. This should prevent the double touches happening between body and kick/dribbling, making the ball get kicked away and therefore making the player lose control of the ball. This isn't a perfect solution but it should at least make the ball more controllable. We might revisit other ways to fix this issue later.[/p][p]- Adjusted GK sideways dive hitbox animations and size some more.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.4.4
notes.notes: [p]- Reverted the oval kicking/dribbling/tackling hitbox back to a square of similar size.[/p][p]- Tweaked kick charge.... again.[/p][p]- Tweaked GK sideways dive hitbox sizes and animations.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.4.3
notes.notes: [p]- Reduced kicking/dribbling/tackling hitboxes forward reach and switched them to use a oval hitbox instead of a square.[/p][p]- Tweaked kick charge a little more.[/p][p]- Buffed header power by 5%.[/p][p]- Added/changed discord server list in the community tab to include the recently endorsed community servers.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.4.2
notes.notes: [p]- Increased initial kick charge speed very slightly again.[/p][p]- Very slightly increased hitbox size to find the perfect balance between dribbling and defending.[/p][p]- Increased GK sideways dive hitboxes size.[/p][p]- Fixed leg accessory meshes clipping issues.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.4.1
notes.notes: [p]- Fixed players getting stuck during throw ins.[/p][p]- Fixed hair colors being bugged.[/p][p]- Slightly reduced body tilt in general and removed it while jumping.[/p][p]- Fixed footsteps sounds not playing.[/p][p]- Fixed arm sleeve right not being sized correctly for different body mass sizes.[/p][p]- Adjusted kick charge to be a little slower to balance shooting.[/p][p]- Adjusted gravity a little lower.[/p][p]- Changed raise hand and point finger to be a single press that holds on for 3 seconds then resets instead of needing to hold the keys.[/p][p]- Removed view distance and effects quality from video settings because they have no effect on visuals or performance. Also moved stadiums settings to the bottom of the video settings list.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.4.0
notes.notes: [p]- Slightly increased gravity.[/p][p]- Increased initial kick charge speed. This should allow a bit snappier passing and shooting.[/p][p]- Decreased kicking/dribbling/tackling hitbox size. This should nerf defense a little bit.[/p][p]- Fixed GK dive hitboxes to not save low shots when diving high, and not save high shots when diving low.[/p][p]- Fixed backwards dive deflection so it should actually be useful to stop chipped shots. Might still need a bit more tweaking.[/p][p]- Changed GK catches/deflections. The speed threshold for a shot to be deflected by the GK instead of a catch has been increased overall, but now shots will deflect, not catch, even when the ball is in the center of the GK's body.[/p][p]- Made tweaks to the player model. The shoulders are less wide and the models were made to look a bit slimmer.[/p][p]- Lots of animation tweaks. Hopefully the game should look and feel better with these tweaks.[/p][p]- Added the ability to point your finger where you're aiming. Default key is Q.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.3.9
notes.notes: [p]- Slightly decreased gravity[/p][p]- Slightly decreased ball friction.[/p][p]- Changed all touches on the ball so they don't cancel 100% of the balls momentum. This make the game feel and play more realistically.[/p][p]- Very slightly decreased kicking/dribbling/tackling hitbox width.[/p][p]- Increased kick, dribble and juggle charge speeds.[/p][p]- Fixed chip shots being weak.[/p][p]- Decreased acceleration to where it should be perfectly balanced.[/p][p]- Slightly increased touch deceleration to where it should be perfectly balanced.[/p][p]- Added mouse movement clamp during GK dives to prevent 90 degree/180 degree turns.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.3.7
notes.notes: [p]The nerf in the 2.3.6 update was overdone and this update reverts some of the changes but not all of them. Really sorry for the continued changes to mechanics, just trying to get the right balance. Here's what changed:[/p][p]- Acceleration set back to the same as 2.3.5[/p][p]- Kept the bigger tackling hitbox from 2.3.6[/p][p]- Kept the dribble charge change from 2.3.6[/p][p]- Very slightly increase kick charge initial speed.[/p][p]- Slightly moved dribbling hitbox backwards to give a tiny bit more reach behind a player's feet[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.3.6
notes.notes: [p]The recent switch to DX12 and performance improvements in the 2.3.4 update drastically changed the speed of everything in the game like acceleration, faster kick/dribble charges. On top of that the kicking/dribbling/tackling hitbox size was decreased.[/p][p][/p][p] This made the game heavily geared towards dribbling. This was not intentional and this update is to put the game back to being more focused on defending and passing but still keep the performance improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's a list of what changed:[/p][p]- Decreased acceleration to be similar to the movement before the 2.3.4 update.[/p][p]- Slightly increased touch deceleration, it's similar to before the 2.3.4 update.[/p][p]- Increased kicking/dribbling/tackling hitbox width to half the difference of the most recent size decrease but decreased length and moved it forward. There's now less reach behind your player's feet but the same amount of reach forward.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.3.5
notes.notes: [p]- Fixed curve feeling crappy.[/p][p]- Fixed touch decel being slightly heavier, this was an accident, sorry.[/p][p]- Adjusted new UI color scheme gradient so it should be a bit easier on the eyes.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.3.4
notes.notes: [p]- Decreased kicking/dribbling/tackling hitbox size a bit more.[/p][p]- Tweaked curve calculations a bit to allow more curve at lower power.[/p][p]- Fixed player spawned balls not being destroyed after a person respawns or leaves a lobby.[/p][p]- Changed code for processing ranked match results to prevent losses being caused by leaving fast after a match ends.[/p][p]- Added editable text to the tournament board for the Champion's Park map. This allows hosts to write the competition(tournament/league) name as well as the winning team's name on the tournament boards. This should allow for some great photo op moments and creating good memories.[/p][p]- Changed main menu color scheme to be white and blue, same as UE4 color scheme.[/p][p]- Added copy player ID button to multiplayer list & stats items + player profiles.[/p][p]- Switched from Direct X 11 to Direct X 12. We're kind of testing this out to see what's better overall for performance and maybe revert it if DX11 is better. There's also commands to launch the game using DX11 if your performance ends up being worse with DX12. We'll add a post for how to use the DX11 command in our FAQ channel in the official discord.[/p][p]- Played around with render settings to hopefully make the game perform more optimally.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with Champion's Park map causing worse performance when shadows are set to medium or higher.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.3.0

It's a 6v6 field with a trophy stage that can be used for tournament/league finals.[/p][p]- Added video settings for turning stadium seats and crowds on/off.[/p][p]- Increased gravity slightly and tweaked ball physics.[/p][p]- Decreased baseline for kick height sensitivity. You might have to adjust your kick sensitivity as a result of this change.[/p][p]- Decreased kicking/dribbling/tackling hitbox size a bit.[/p][p]- Adjusted jump slowdown to reduce exploits related to it.[/p][p]- Tweaked body/ball collision to be more controllable.[/p][p]- Changed GK pass back rule to be that you can no longer pickup the ball during a pass back and therefore can't get a handball, similar to UE4.[/p][p]- Fixed GK being able to pickup the ball after just releasing it. After 10 seconds it will auto-drop the ball and they won't be able to pick it up again until someone else touches the ball.[/p][p]- Fixed GK taking a touch with his feet, then picking the ball up causing a handball when it shouldn't.[/p][p]- Made GK deflections go slightly more forward to prevent GKs accidently deflecting saves into the net.[/p][p]- Made some changes to fix bugs related to throw in and trip animations.[/p][p]- Increased free kick/corner kick shield size.[/p][p]- Changed code for detection of when a foul is inside a team's penalty box. This should fix penalties being triggered when fouled just on the edge of the box.[/p][p]- Fixed disconnecting then rejoining getting rid of red cards in ranked.[/p][p]- Fixed up more penalty shootout bugs. They should be functioning as intended now.[/p][p]- Added penalty shootout only overtime mode. This skips extra time and goes straight to a penalty shootout.[/p][p]- Adjusted voice chat volume setting ranges and fixed volume not adjusting properly when changing them.[/p][p]- Fixed global mutes not effecting voice chat. notes.title: About the UE5/PSO 2 update
notes.notes:
[p][b]This is not the finish line for PSO 2, it's the start line.[/b][/p][p]I understand that the UE5 update is lacking gameplay and functionality wise and needs lots of fixes and tweaks. We are aware and are going to be working on improving it as much as possible. In a few weeks the game could be in a better state than the UE4 version of the game. There will be at least 1 update a week if not 2 for the coming months, so please don't give up hope yet.

This is also why the UE4 version of the game is still available with Steam beta branches until the end of August.[/p][p][/p][p][b]To play the UE4 version of the game follow these steps:[/b][/p][p]1. Right click on PSO in your Steam library[/p][p]2. Click properties[/p][p]3, Click on betas tab[/p][p]4. Click the beta participation selection box[/p][p]5. Click ue4_pso and then it should start to download[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2.1.0
notes.notes: [p]-Sprint speed increased from 835 to 850, same sprint speed as ue4[/p][p]-Acceleration increase to be similar to ue4, this should basically fix dribbling and make it feel like ue4 dribbling.[/p][p]-Kicking/dribbling hitbox size increase, this should also help people with missed dribbles/kicks.[/p][p]-Jump slowdown similar to ue4, this will prevent bunny hopping.[/p][p]-Kick charge time decrease from 2 seconds to 1.5 seconds, this will make kick charges much faster like ue4 which will make passing and shooting much better.[/p][p]-Increased gravity, this should make the ball feel more similar to unreal 4[/p][p]-Attempt to fix fouls getting players stuck, pretty sure it's fixed but not 100% sure until we test it.[/p][p]-Attempt to fix gk releases like roll, drop kick and throws having inconsistent heights, should fix drop kicks sometimes staying low to the ground or going too high, pretty sure it's fixed but not 100% until we test it.[/p][p]-Fixed offsides not resetting for a player when the other team touches it, then other team touches it right after.[/p][p]-Fixed spectator broadcast cameras spawning incorrectly on night time maps.[/p][p]-Fixed stutter for NA and SA servers when a player joins a lobby.[/p][p]-Changed 6v6 match length to 8 minutes by default, and 8v8 to 12 minutes. This should help matches go faster and speed up grinding coins in ranked.[/p]

notes.title: UE5/PSO 2 Update!!!
notes.notes: [p]Ladies and gentleman the time has finally come for the UE5/PSO 2 update to be released. It's been worked on for just over 1.5 years and it's finally ready. Featuring a new game engine and lots of extra features, it should bring PSO back to life.[/p][list][*][p]New game engine (Unreal Engine 5)[/p][/*][*][p]Better anti-cheat[/p][/*][*][p]Ranked modes[/p][/*][*][p]Detailed player and team profiles[/p][/*][*][p]Better customization[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay tweaks[/p][/*][/list][p]The update has been improving consistently for the past few months and while this version of the game is not quite perfect yet, it's in a solid state and worth releasing at this point. This way people can play and enjoy it, and we can also start getting a wider variety of feedback on what to improve and fix.[/p][p][/p][p]Gameplay may need more tweaking to get it feeling just right, and we will be working on it over the next few weeks. There's already lots more customization items that have yet to be added into the game and will be added over the following weeks as well. There's also 2D stadium crowds that are almost ready and will be added in the next few weeks too.[/p][p][/p][p]The Unreal Engine 4 version of the game is still playable using Steam beta branches. The beta branch is named "ue4_pso". This will be playable until the end of August at which point it will be shut down permanently.[/p][p][/p][p]To get more involved with the community and provide feedback be sure to join the official discord:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/prosocceronline"]discord.gg/prosocceronline[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We also have a functioning company website now as well as a page for Pro Soccer Online:[/p][p][url="https://www.skywallstudiosllc.com"]https://www.skywallstudiosllc.com[/url][/p][p][url="https://skywallstudiosllc.com/prosocceronline"]https://skywallstudiosllc.com/prosocceronline[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We also have new social media pages we will be using to promote the game as well. We don't have much posted yet but will start posting soon:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@prosocceronlineofficial"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/prosocceronlineofficial/#"]https://www.instagram.com/prosocceronlineofficial/#[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@prosocceronlineofficial"]https://www.tiktok.com/@prosocceronlineofficial[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Beta 1.4.4
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone. For those of you who don't know me I'm Brylos the lead developer of Pro Soccer Online. As many of you know the game has been stagnant in terms of updates for a while now. This is due to a few things; me being burnt/checked out of dev work, biting off more than I could chew with the overhauls I was implementing. I have decided to scrap the major overhauls that were planned that you can see in previous news/announcements, and instead accept and work to improve the current art style in terms of player models, stadiums and UI.

To get the ball rolling again with updates and get me back into the flow of working on the game I have put together a small gameplay update. We've been testing it for about 2 weeks now and I think we've found the sweet spot for the gameplay mechanic changes. It fixes some things and hopefully should optimize gameplay overall. The plans afterwards are to improve the multiplayer match UI, and then either switch to improving player models and/or stadiums, if not that then work on the team based gamemode that is planned.

Hope you guys like it. Further tweaks will be made if needed. Here are the changes:

[list]
[*]Reworked touch slowdown programming to work more consistently, fix abusable bugs related to it, and added smaller touch slowdown when not sprinting.
[*]Reworked kick (mouse 1) charge pattern to reduce it's usability for dribbling.
[*]Reworked dribble (mouse 2) charge and power to be a bit harder to keep the ball close to your feet. This should punish overdribblers and make the game a bit more team/passing focused.
[*]Reworked juggle (middle mouse) charge and power.
[*]Reverted to full WASD diving for goalkeeping. The goalkeeper now has full directional control over what height he dives at with WASD keys. The hitbox has been reduced in size and dive length was slightly reduced to go along with this change. It should make the goalkeeping more skillful and realistic.
[*]Changed some code to reduce the frequency of fouls occuring from slide tackles.
[*]Buffed slide tackle hitboxes slightly.
[*]Slightly increased ball gravity.
[/list]

Be sure to join the official discord to get involved with the community, hear the latest news and give feedback: discord.gg/prosocceronline

Hello, lead developer of Pro Soccer Online here. I apologize for the multiple changes to goalkeeper mechanics. I understand that it can be frustrating for the mechanics to be changing so much. What happened was the WASD diving was added in the Beta 1.3 patch, and many people complained that it didn't control well, so I reverted it in the Beta 1.3.2 patch to jump diving and got many people complaining for removing WASD diving. We spent a few days discussing what the better control scheme is and I have decided the best way for it to work is the WASD diving but a modified version. The meta previously with WASD diving was low shots. To combat this low dives have been removed, mid height dives will save low shots, and there are still high dives. Jump diving has been disabled. I believe this is the best control scheme overall. Once again, sorry for the drastic changes. Hope you all understand. Thanks.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.2
notes.notes:
This update offers gameplay changes, various quality of life improvements, and bug fixes.

[list]
[*]Slightly decreased foot/kick hitbox size. This is to hopefully make both dribbling and defending more skillfull.
[*]Increased head hitbox size
[*]Added gk deflections when standing.
[*]Increased kick power by about 10%. This should hopefully encourage more passing play and buff shooting a bit. This also effects dribbling and juggling power.
[*]Slightly increase gravity of the ball.
[*]Added captains. This replaces the kit voting system. Captains control the team kits. Also improved UI for voting and swapping with another player.
[*]Added new icons next to players names for hosts, captains, yellow cards, and red cards.
[*]Changed gk catch indicator position and image. Now has an image of gk gloves to the left of the kick bar. Should be much more visible this way.
[*]Added icon next to the kickbar to show if you have a yellow card or not.
[*]Changed matchmaking to quickplay. Now instead of waiting in the main menu, it will put you and your party into a server. If one already exists, it will join it, if not it will create a new server. This may not fix long wait times, but this way people can practice while waiting.
[*]Improved the match summary menu. It now shows a full team of players, and also shows various stats for each team.
[*]Stat tracking and achievements work in custom lobbies now. Regulation requires minimum of 4 players per team, 3v3 requires at least 2 per team. Matches with single keeper do not track stats for the goalkeeper.
[*]Added mechanic where if the ball hits a player, it will apply an impulse to slow down the ball. This will hopefully make controlling the ball with the players body a lot better, while still feeling natural and somewhat random.
[*]Changed throw ins to not allow teammates so close to the throw in spot. This will stop players dropping the ball for teammates in the safe area on throw ins. To balance this, throw in power is increased significantly.
[*]Added mechanic that pushes opposing players out of the penalty box when the goalkeeper catches the ball and puts a shield up to prevent players abusing the goalkeeper trying to distribute the ball.
[*]Fixed away gk uniform not working correctly in My Team menu.
[*]Fixed chat not displaying custom team names and colors.
[*]Fixed match summary not displaying custom teams.
[*]Fixed ball halo not setting for spawned balls.
[*]Fixed corner flags and offsides lines not using custom team colors.
[/list]

notes.title: RELEASE DAY!!!
notes.notes: After months of testing, Pro Soccer Online is launching into Early Access on Steam. Thank you to everyone who helped with testing, donations and sharing with others. It wouldn't be where it is without you. You guys da real MVP. Be sure to share with friends and social media. Some of the next few steps in development will be getting translations added, improving matchmaking and fixing any bugs. After that it will shift towards a possible graphics overhaul, general improvements, lots more customization items with microtransactions, and possibly transition to free 2 play. After that, the focus will be game modes such as MyTeam and maybe others. Enjoy the game :)
